title: A three-replica quorum during a partition
method: Synthetic topology: three voting replicas split into components of two and one. The example requires two votes to commit. Bars count reachable voters, not successful requests or an uptime forecast. Elections, storage health and client routing are outside this count.
alt: A three-replica quorum during a partition. Connected cluster: 3 reachable voters; Majority component: 2 reachable voters; Minority component: 1 reachable voters. Illustrative values.
